entries.title: Note
entries.description:
Hello

> [!NOTE]
>
> Useful information that users should know, even when skimming content.

Goodbye

timeline.description:
> [!NOTE]
>
> Alerts render in the History table too.

entries.title: Tip
entries.description:
> [!TIP]
> Helpful advice for doing things better or more easily.

The body sits on the line straight after the marker here, with no blank quote line.

entries.title: Important
entries.description:
> [!IMPORTANT]
>
> Key information users need to know to achieve their goal.
>
> Alerts can span multiple paragraphs and contain **bold text**, `code`, and [links](https://roadie.io).

entries.title: Warning
entries.description:
> [!WARNING]
>
> Urgent info that needs immediate user attention to avoid problems.

Lowercase markers work as well:

> [!caution]
>
> Advises about risks or negative outcomes of certain actions.

entries.title: Control (no alerts)
entries.description:
Nothing below should be turned into an alert label.

> A plain blockquote stays a plain blockquote.

> [!SOMETHING]
>
> Unknown markers are left alone.

An inline mention of [!NOTE] in a sentence is untouched.

    > [!NOTE]
    > Indented code blocks are untouched.
